subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: What upgrade contract should OpenClaw provide for existing DeepInfra configurations that set `nativeBaseUrl`?
rationale: The PR cannot safely infer that a custom endpoint configured for native `/v1/inference` also serves `/v1/openai/videos`; choosing whether to preserve, migrate, or intentionally break that shipped behavior requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Preserve legacy endpoint semantics
options.body: Use the OpenAI videos API for the default and `baseUrl` paths, but retain native inference behavior when `nativeBaseUrl` is explicitly configured and test both modes.

options.title: Add an explicit migration
options.body: Deprecate `nativeBaseUrl` through a documented, owner-approved doctor migration only where the destination endpoint can be determined safely.

options.title: Accept the breaking reinterpretation
options.body: Intentionally remap all legacy values, with explicit release notes and upgrade proof showing the supported custom-endpoint expectations.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy endpoint semantics
recommendation.body: Use the OpenAI videos API for the default and `baseUrl` paths, but retain native inference behavior when `nativeBaseUrl` is explicitly configured and test both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a shipped provider-config compatibility decision requiring the repository's explicit product authority rather than a mechanical contributor choice.
